In the VPN settings, open SwitchDNS and enable \"Always-on VPN\". Leave \"Block connections without VPN\" off, otherwise the internet stops working.

Pause on Wi-Fi login pages (e.g. train or hotel hotspots)
This app is smaller than a photo. Support its development on Liberapay.

What does the app do?
It sets a different DNS server for your apps by starting a local VPN that only carries the DNS setting. Your traffic is not routed through it and nothing is logged.

Setup
1. Pick a DNS server (tap the card). Own servers are marked ★ and listed first; long-press one in the list to delete it.
2. Tap "Start VPN" and allow the VPN request once.
3. Optional: add the "SwitchDNS" tile to the quick settings.

Apps
Either all apps except the selected ones, or only the selected ones use the DNS server.

Network rules
Use on mobile data and/or Wi-Fi. On Wi-Fi login pages (train, hotel) the app pauses until you are logged in.

Always on
"Start on device boot" or system VPN settings → SwitchDNS → "Always-on VPN". Leave "Block connections without VPN" off.

Save / load
The icons at the top store all settings (incl. own servers and app list) in a file and restore them, e.g. on a new phone.
Also lists apps and services without a launcher icon, e.g. Google Play services.
Own servers (★) are listed first; long-press one to delete it.
